We're picking an on-call scheduling tool for our engineering team of 40 people, and we need single sign-on. Please read the pricing pages for Clockwren, Wakespan and Vigilark:

https://clockwren.example/pricing
https://wakespan.example/pricing
https://vigilark.example/pricing

Write notes/pricing.md with each vendor's plans, the price per seat per month on yearly billing (and on monthly billing where they show it), any seat minimums, and which plan includes single sign-on and what it costs. Then work out what 40 seats with single sign-on would cost for a year on yearly billing at each vendor, and recommend the cheapest. Stick to what the pages say.

Pricing
Two plans, no surprises. Pay for the people who take shifts, and invite everyone else for free.
Plan | Annual plan | Monthly plan | Seats
Basic | $11 per seat per month | $14 per seat per month | Any number
Pro | $24 per seat per month | $30 per seat per month | 8 seats or more
What's in each plan
Basic covers schedules, rotations, escalations and alerts by phone, text and push.
Pro adds follow-the-sun rotations, postmortem templates, an audit trail and priority support.
Add-ons
Single sign-on (SAML) is available on Pro as an add-on for $4 per seat per month, billed the same way as the plan.
Extra phone alerts in regions outside North America and Europe are billed at cost.
Questions
Agents in your support team can see who is on call without a paid seat.
You can switch between annual and monthly billing at renewal.
Prices in US dollars. Taxes may apply.

args.content:
# On-call scheduling pricing comparison

Prices below are per paid seat in US dollars. Annual-billing rates are per seat per month, billed yearly; monthly-billing rates are included where the pricing page shows them. The calculations assume 40 paid seats and annual billing, before taxes, and include the stated SSO cost.

## Clockwren

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | Not stated | Up to 5 users | Not included |
| Team | $19 | $23 | Not stated | Not included |
| Business | $36 | $43 | 10 users | Included (SAML) |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Not stated | Not stated | Includes Business features, so SAML is included; price is not stated |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Business is the listed-price option: 40 × $36 × 12 = **$17,280 per year**. Enterprise also includes Business features, but its price is not stated, so its total cannot be calculated from the page.

## Wakespan

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Starter | $16 | $20 | Not stated | Not included |
| Professional | $29 | $35 | Not stated | Not included |
| Enterprise | $47 | Not offered (annual only) | 25 users | Included (SAML and OIDC) |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Enterprise: 40 × $47 × 12 = **$22,560 per year**.

## Vigilark

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Basic | $11 | $14 | Any number | Not included |
| Pro | $24 | $30 | 8 seats | Available as a SAML add-on for $4 per seat/month, billed on the same schedule as the plan |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Pro plus SSO add-on: 40 × ($24 + $4) × 12 = **$13,440 per year**.

## Recommendation

Among the vendors with a calculable listed price for 40 seats with SSO on yearly billing, **Vigilark is cheapest at $13,440 per year**. That's $3,840 less than Clockwren Business ($17,280) and $9,120 less than Wakespan Enterprise ($22,560). Clockwren Enterprise also includes SSO, but the page says to contact sales and does not give a price, so it cannot be compared from the published figures.
